mentions.name: XferLang
mentions.description: XferLang is a data-transfer and configuration language designed as an alternative to JSON. Its features include no commas, no need for escape characters, processing instructions, extensible data-substitution rules, and support for comments. It is currently implemented in .NET, with plans to rewrite the core in Rust and provide language wrappers around that core.
mentions.problem: Serves as an alternative to JSON for data transfer and configuration.
